item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day is full of prompts that ask the same thing: does this moment support the life you're building? Use them. When a thought shows up, ask whether you're reading minds or projecting. Choose a perspective on purpose. Meet old patterns with grace, not judgment. Keep your home calm and safe. Your action: at noon, pause for one minute and ask that question out loud.
